query: What is the optimal primary effect-size metric for IoT adoption outcomes (uptake, intention, acceptance) to maximize cross-study comparability and allow back-transformation?

response.query: What is the optimal primary effect-size metric for IoT adoption outcomes (uptake, intention, acceptance) to maximize cross-study comparability and allow back-transformation?
response.answer: The optimal primary effect-size metric for IoT adoption outcomes is Cohen's d, maximizing comparability and allowing back-transformation. It is a standardized mean difference metric.

results.title: Putting Energy to Work! Reference code: EnDev/2024/07/PUE/Your ...
results.content: Project Title: Energising Development (EnDev) – Putting Energy to Work! GIZ implements the Energising Development (EnDev) project in Malawi and is looking for skilled and passionate team members to help improve access to energy throughout Malawi. Component is co-financed by the European Delegation to Malawi and aims at creating an impact in regard to strengthening the market for needs-based, climate-friendly technologies and services for PUE and, thereby, contribute to the socio-economic development of Malawi. • Support in the technical management of interventions to promote the productive use of energy (PUE) market in Malawi. • Coordination of the dialogue with the Renewable Energy Industries Association and the PUE Technical Working Group. • Coordination of dialogue with implementing partners (in particular with the Renewable Energy Industries Association of Malawi – REIAMA and Green Girls Platform. • 1-2 years of professional experience or internships in the PUE or development sector are advantageous. • Initial experience working with GIZ, or similar international cooperation projects is an advantage.
